html lang=en on Persian RTL product

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Homepage SSR returns 200 with usable Persian copy
Strong security headers via ArvanCloud (HSTS, XFO, nosniff)
True 404 marketing paths emit meta robots noindex

findings.title: Missing robots.txt
findings.description: GET /robots.txt returns 404 HTML soft-404 (~7.7KB) with no crawl policy or sitemap pointer.
findings.recommendation: Add Next.js app/robots.ts allowing / and disallowing /home,/backtest,/battle,/chart,/admin,/login,/api/

findings.title: Missing XML sitemap
findings.description: /sitemap.xml returns 404. Only a tiny public URL set exists; discovery is link-only.
findings.recommendation: Add app/sitemap.ts listing indexable marketing URLs only; reference from robots.txt

findings.title: /lessons CSR bailout
findings.description: Raw HTML contains BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING; crawlable body effectively empty.
findings.recommendation: SSR/SSG lesson content or noindex until contentful

findings.title: Wrong html lang
findings.description: Root layout sets lang=en while product copy and UI are Persian RTL.

findings.title: Login pages indexable
findings.recommendation: robots: { index: false, follow: false } on login metadata; reinforce in robots.txt

findings.title: Marketing HTML no-store
findings.description: Homepage Cache-Control private,no-store; ArvanCloud x-cache BYPASS; ~371KB HTML.
findings.recommendation: CDN-cache anonymous marketing responses separately from auth HTML

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage ~633 Persian tokens with clear H1, features, pricing, FAQ

findings.title: Missing legal and About pages
findings.recommendation: Publish Privacy, Terms, About, and public support contact in footer

findings.title: No topical content cluster
findings.description: Public site is essentially one page; /lessons adds no crawlable teaching content.
findings.recommendation: Ship 4–6 Persian guides + case studies; fix lessons SSR

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T authority
findings.description: Weighted E-E-A-T ~35; no expert/org entity pages or proof artifacts.
findings.recommendation: About page with org entity + real session case studies

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Strong homepage title: Candelo | بک‌تست و بازپخش بازار

findings.title: No canonical or social meta
findings.description: No rel=canonical, og:*, or twitter:* on homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add canonical + Open Graph + Twitter Card with 1200x630 image

findings.title: Weak cross-page internal links
findings.description: No footer cluster to legal/about/lessons; brand disambiguation weak vs similar names.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.description: Zero JSON-LD/Microdata/RDFa on public pages; pricing and FAQ unmarked.
findings.recommendation: SSR JSON-LD @graph: Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, AggregateOffer (IRR); optional FAQPage for GEO only

findings.title: LCP ~2.9s lab
findings.description: Desktop/mobile LCP ~2880ms on H1; dual web fonts + large HTML; eNamad third-party hang observed.
findings.recommendation: Self-host/subset fonts, defer eNamad, reduce HTML, cache marketing at CDN

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Homepage SSR Persian FAQ/pricing is quotable when fetched

findings.title: Poor AI discoverability
findings.description: No llms.txt, no schema, no sitemap, Common Crawl domain absent, brand confusion risk.
findings.recommendation: Add llms.txt, schema, entity pages; build citability cluster

categories.name: Images
what_works: Hero product visual is SVG (not a huge raster LCP)

findings.title: Empty image alts and missing OG image
findings.description: All 3 imgs have empty alt; no og:image; logo lazy-loaded in header.
findings.recommendation: Meaningful alts, dedicated OG PNG/JPG, eager-load logo, compress + cache
